title.narrative: Encroacher Bush Biomass Power Project (40MW Otjikoto Biomass Power Station (OBPS)

description.narrative: Namibia currently imports 60-70% of its electricity annually from fossil-fuel (coal) based electricity networks of its neighbouring countries. At the same time, Namibia is facing a lack of own generation capacity. The project therefore aims to support the implementation of two mitigation actions under the NDC: (1) the decarbonation of the electricity sector/supply in Namibia with the construction of the 40MW Otjikoto Biomass Power Station (OBPS) by NamPower by replacing fossil fuel electricity imports; and (2) new carbon intensive investments in a local biomass supply chain based on encroacher bush. Both will contribute to Namibia’s electricity security, the restoration of 16,400 Ha savannah land per year and increased soil capacity for carbon sequestration. The project will directly leverage EUR 196 m for the construction of the OBPS (incl. a EUR 100 m AFD loan) and fuel supply chain activities (farming and harvesting); and directly mitigate 2.4 tons CO2e over 25 years.
